title: Validation rules for exposure data
text:

Touchstone

Touchstone
 writes validation errors to the
 import log file. To view the validation error table, log in to the 
Client Portal
, navigate to the 
Developer Zone
, click the
 
Touchstone

 Databases
 link (under "Database Documentation"), and then search
 for "tValidationError Table". The
 Description
 field for the
 
ValidationErrorCode
 column lists the code that
 represents the validation error.
